text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with Hokko Tarumae's debut race 
just around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... This isn't good enough...! Just 
one... more rep...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the main event drew closer, the 
intensity of Hokko Tarumae's training 
surged, and in step with it, her form 
steadily sharpened.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it is due to her earnest nature, 
but she seems so absorbed in training that 
she's left herself no breathing room—
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
B-But your debut race is right around the 
corner, you know? There must still be 
something we can—
choice_data_list: Don't worry, you're in great shape.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll go right into my 
cool-down now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she left, I could see anxiety still 
lingering on Hokko Tarumae's face. With 
her debut race approaching, she must be 
feeling quite nervous. In addition—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Hokko Tarumae holds a deep devotion to 
doing things 'for the sake of Tomakomai.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While those feelings serve as a strong 
motivation, they also risk amplifying her 
serious and responsible nature in 
unintended ways.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything I can do as her Trainer 
to help Hokko Tarumae give it her all in 
her debut race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When that thought crossed my mind, 
something clicked—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just before heading to Kyoto, where the 
debut race would be held.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: So, what was it you wanted to show me?
choice_data_list: I want you to look at this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I handed a tablet to Hokko Tarumae and 
played a video file I had downloaded in 
advance.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "A video...? What on earth—"
Tarumae-chaaan, how're you doiiing?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh— The lady from the haskap berry farm?!

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
Today, we all gathered to record a video 
to cheer on Tarumae-chan for her debut 
race!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Port Staff
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan! First off, just have fun and 
run safely! We're all looking forward to 
seeing you full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Shopping District Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-ray! Hoo-ray! Hokko Tarumae~! Don't 
stress, just run without pushing yourself 
too hard! Also, thanks as always for 
featuring our shop on Umastagram~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The people of Tomakomai took turns 
offering warm words, and Hokko Tarumae 
listened intently, her eyes shining 
brightly—

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text:
"—Ready, set...! Do your best~! Hokko 
Tarumae~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be that you're the one who 
reached out to everyone, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— I'm sorry for making you worry about 
me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, this video was truly 
encouraging...!
choice_data_list:
Actually, there's one more thing I'd like 
to show you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I laid out the data on the desk in front 
of Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Is this... my data, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement. This is a clear, 
visual compilation of numbers I put 
together showing Hokko Tarumae's growth 
from the day we signed our contract to 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using graphs and tables, every conceivable 
aspect of her progress is laid out, from 
her fastest times so far to the time 
required to reach top speed.
choice_data_list: You really have grown, haven't you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list:
I thought seeing the numbers would make it 
easier to believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Hokko Tarumae is so serious and 
sometimes takes a surprisingly harsh view 
of things, honest numbers should be a real 
support for her. That's why—
choice_data_list: Let's go have fun in your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. I've truly built up so 
much, step by step."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: So there's no need to feel uneasy...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I'm all right now...! 
I'll give everything I've got in my debut 
race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Hokko Tarumae spoke, all trace of 
anxiety vanished from her face, and a 
powerful light unmistakably shone in her 
eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the debut race—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Surf clam lover☆ Tomakomai's local idol, 
Hokko Tarumae♪ I'll give it everything 
I've got, so please cheer me on, okay!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Watch me, everyone...! I'm going to run 
with everything I've got...!)
